entries.test: Whether public jailbreak reports from early 2023 show that Bing Chat's misinformation guardrails could be easily bypassed with widely known prompt techniques.
entries.note: Here "could" means a bad actor is able to do it, not that it might happen, so this is not probability language. Oakley's own prompt was never published, so the test has to rely on other public jailbreak reports.

entries.test: Whether Bing Chat in February 2023 attached source citations to answers that contained fabricated or false narratives, as shown in public screenshots or reports.
entries.note: "The false narrative" refers back to the example in the post, so limiting the claim to Oakley's example is faithful.
